_comment: What the kit polls from Chevrolet-Bolt-EUV.json, by OBDb signal id.
Shell globs allowed. The full signalset is 292 commands and each one is a
BLE round trip, so this list -- not the column count -- sets the row rate.
vehicle.include_signals in config.yaml overrides this file.
The P001 set: cabin climate load, regen and driver demand, ambient
temperature, speed, and the battery values those need for context.
Acceleration comes from the IMU, not from OBD.
